notes: These rules annotate existing factual domains; they do not change product draws or assert missing values.
Highlight expressions select useful candidates, not mandatory marketing claims. SKU controls and price never fill highlights.
Useful fixed materials, construction and care remain literal content. Ordinary anatomy and unrelated excluded extras are not new feature dimensions.
No new family manufacturing defaults are inferred from a single concept. Existing inherited constants retain their origin.

footwear.note: Emphasize the actual use: cushioning for running, terrain/protection for hiking, shape/heel for dress shoes, insulation for winter. Fixed closed-heel anatomy is not a selling point.

jackets.note: Keep waterproof declarations distinct from measured ratings; insulation and weather protection do not become guarantees.

tops.note: Main fabric, fit and neckline dominate; whole-garment versus trim composition must stay distinct. All care statements share one display area.

trousers.note: Material, cut and useful pockets/conversion matter. Hardware inventories and ordinary belt-loop anatomy do not warrant independent highlights.

knitwear.note: Main knit versus rib/trim scope stays explicit. Do not promote zipper insertion pins or garment-component IDs.

headphones.note: Preserve battery-test mode, case-assisted versus wearable runtime and headset microphone-route conditions.

phones.note: Use OS, display/camera and battery/support. Storage and colour remain buying choices; cable capabilities are not device charging guarantees.

phone_cases.note: Exact device compatibility and charging conditions matter. No inferred impact protection or magnetic strength.

chargers.note: Group solo/simultaneous and PPS bounds coherently; combined output is not per-port output. Bundle cable choices remain controls.

keyboards.note: Layout is a buying choice. Adjustment, connection and switch types matter; artificial controls and excluded mouse inventories do not.

laptops.note: RAM/storage may be choices. Keep reference configuration on weight/geometry and avoid claiming game or editing performance from components.

tablets.note: Pen platform/power and included pen are distinct. Storage/cellular/bundle controls must retain their existing presentation annotations.

monitors.note: Resolution, refresh, colour and connections have declared bases; no untested colour accuracy or cable bandwidth claims.

ssd.note: NVMe, SATA and HDD remain distinct. Capacity is a buying choice; advertised versus achieved speeds and raw versus usable storage stay separate.

memory_cards.note: Class minimum write speed and advertised maxima are separate statements. An adapter does not upgrade bus or capacity support.

printer_ink.note: Keep per-colour declared yield with its protocol; do not sum colour yields into a combined print yield. Region/model compatibility stays explicit.

camera_lenses.note: Mount may be a selector. Sensor coverage, nominal versus actual geometry, aperture endpoints and macro effective aperture need their original qualifications.

cat_food.note: Retain complete versus complementary role and partial ingredient disclosure scope. No individual dietary-suitability guarantee.

dog_food.note: Declared age/body-weight target and complete/complementary role matter; analytical label values are not individual feeding recommendations.

cat_litter.note: Keep clumping and fragrance-free declarations; no invented dust/odour performance. Disposal rules stay scoped to declared advice.

pet_bowls.note: Fountains need power/cleaning information; slow-feed and raised designs need geometry. Do not present them as tested health benefits.

pet_harnesses.note: Keep fit bands with size controls, front/back attachment and padding; suppress inventories of attached ordinary hardware.

pet_toys.note: Chew, tug, soft, puzzle and teaser functions differ. Keep supervision/inspection instructions as care/use details, without claiming durability or clinical effects.

kitchen_utensils.note: Function/material/contact surface first. Component-specific heat and cleaning are scoped groups, not whole-tool guarantees.

cookware.note: Whole assembled cookware, body-only and lid-only heat limits remain different. Hob compatibility is not inferred from material names.

pots.note: Keep lid/handle/component heat and care distinctions. Capacity labels, working fill and measured volume are not interchangeable.

towels.note: Declared quick-drying is not a measured drying time. Towel and supplied pouch care may differ, in one care area.

bedding.note: Textile covers, filled duvets and pillows have different features. Keep component-care scopes and nominal versus measured warmth/loft separate.

furniture.note: Keep assembled-use geometry, folded geometry, clear knee space, wall-mount/assembly and load bases separate. Bulky shipping is operational.

toothbrushes.note: Manual and electric brushes differ. Brush/bundle controls and head-platform compatibility remain explicit; no cleaning or dental outcome inference.

brush_heads.note: Compatibility, head geometry and bristle declaration matter; pack count is a buying choice, measured stiffness is not inferred.

moisturizers.note: Declarations describe texture/target/ingredients; no inferred hydration duration or individual tolerance. Packaging internals are secondary.

cleansers.note: Keep diluted versus undiluted pH conditions and partial ingredients. A removal claim is not measured makeup-removal performance.

serums.note: Named declared ingredient percentages keep their weight basis; INCI order, concentration and measured efficacy are different meanings.

foundation.note: Shade is a buying choice. Coverage/finish are label declarations, not clinical skin suitability or SPF guarantees.

beer.note: Taste labels and declared ABV matter; measured persistence/chemistry and brand provenance are separate. Deposit belongs to price/checkout.

wine.note: Keep grape-list completeness, vintage status, label sweetness and residual sugar distinct; deposit is commerce, not a descriptive highlight.
